interpretation: Incompressibility freezes the material bulk Jacobian but not boundary geometry. The remaining pressure and viscous boundary interactions are weighted by F^{-T}. Compression of one material direction can therefore amplify the oriented-area factor even while total volume is exactly preserved. This is a structural coupling channel, not a blow-up theorem.
claim_boundary: Nanson pullback and J=1 are exact smooth-flow identities. The exponential formulas are only for the frozen local Gaussian anchor and do not represent a time-solved Navier-Stokes trajectory.
